title: Starting Odometer of the Term Miles on a Kept-Vehicle Refund — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
For a kept-vehicle refund on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the term miles run from a starting odometer. The starting odometer is read from the purchase deal the contract was sold on, in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records.

| Term counts from | Purchase deal | Starting odometer |
|---|---|---|
| the sale date | delivered after the contract's sale date, with a delivery odometer above the odometer at sale | that delivery odometer |
| the sale date | delivered to the holder's address on or before the sale date | the odometer at sale plus the deal's one-way delivery distance |
| any other case, including every term counted from the vehicle's in-service date | — | the term start odometer |

**Cases (hypothetical; odometer at sale 18340, term start odometer 18340).**
- A deal delivered two days after the sale date at 18402 miles: 18402.
- A deal delivered two days after the sale date at 18340 miles: the delivery odometer is not above the odometer at sale, and the deal was not delivered on or before the sale date. The case falls to the term start odometer, 18340.
- A deal delivered to the holder's address on the sale date, 65 miles one way: 18405.
- A contract sold on its own: 18340.
- A Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap contract, whose term counts from the in-service date: its term start odometer of 0, whatever the deal's delivery.
